title: Fadi and the Stony Ground
logline: Fadi plants a hidden seed in Hanan, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Hanan, who was tender compassion — ground so hard the others laughed when Fadi, who carried seeker of hidden form, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Fadi did not argue; Fadi simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Fadi watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
